selection_rule: Highest frozen confidence within correct and incorrect strata.
preprocessing: EXIF transpose, RGB conversion, optional short-side resize to 256, JPEG quality 95 roundtrip, resize to 224x224, ImageNet normalization.
interpretation_note: Grad-CAM is exploratory and does not establish causal reliance on source-specific shortcuts.
release_note: Absolute local Drive paths are intentionally omitted. The composite figure contains source-image content and remains pending source-rights review.
